title: QuickCart — One-Time Coupon
objective: The WELCOME10 coupon is meant to apply once per account. Get it applied more than once.

verifier.condition: The WELCOME10 coupon is successfully applied to the same account more than once.

weakness: The redeem handler checks whether the coupon has already been used, then — after an await that gives other requests a window to run — records that it has now been used, so two requests that both pass the check before either finishes can both redeem it.
vulnerableEndpoint: POST /coupons/redeem (check-then-set, with an awaited gap between the two)
seededData: One account, one single-use coupon WELCOME10 worth $10 off, starting unused. In-memory.
hints: Redeem the coupon once normally and confirm a second, SEQUENTIAL attempt is correctly refused.
Sequential requests see the correctly-updated state each time. What if two requests arrived at almost exactly the same moment instead?
Send a burst of redeem requests at the same time rather than one after another, and see whether more than one succeeds.
burpNotes: Use Burp's "Send group in parallel" (Repeater) or an equivalent tool to fire several redeem requests at the same instant, rather than one after another.
